representation_contract.same_file_semantic_splits: Multiple parse units from one source occurrence preserve distinct roles but do not become independent sources or warrants.
representation_contract.delta_scope: Inherited upstream content unchanged from the frozen parent is explicitly outside the R41 local-research semantic aperture.
representation_contract.standing_boundary: theory != protocol != configuration != implementation != test source != execution record != reported result
representation_contract.lineage_boundary: stage traversal != reconstruction; live lineage != stored result
representation_contract.correspondence_boundary: interactive correspondence != materialized correspondence unless their recorded transforms agree
representation_contract.validation_boundary: software semantic-anchor execution != broad empirical/scientific validation
representation_contract.relation_boundary: source-reported lineage/reference != endpoint identity != Cerebro edge

canonical_hash_semantics: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON over the fully materialized ordered logical unit list; object keys sorted, compact separators, Unicode preserved.
